results.text: -10 to all tests except Toughness for 1 round.

Blinded for [[1d10]] rounds and Stunned for 1 round. Fellowship permanently reduced by 1.
[[1d5]] levels of Fatigue and Blinded for [[1d10]] hours. Fellowship and Perception permanently reduced by [[1d5]] each.
[[1d10]] levels of Fatigue and permanently Blinded. Roll [[1d10]] for the new Fellowship value, unless it is already 10 or lower.

The target dies. His burning body runs [[2d10]] metres in a random direction (Scatter Diagram); anything flammable it passes, characters included, must pass a Challenging (+0) Agility test or catch fire.
